summary: Read a string of length between 1 and 100000. Every character is a left parenthesis, a right parenthesis, or a lowercase English letter. Delete as few parentheses as possible, at any indexes, so the remaining text is a valid parenthesis string. Empty text, text made only of letters, two valid texts placed one after another, and one valid text wrapped by a matching pair all count as valid. Write any string that is valid after such a deletion. The length bound is 100000.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
